description: Novel Create Center：网文创作流水线——选题、三层问答开书、设定冻结、三级大纲、黄金三章、日更连载、五域审稿与修订闭环、拆书喂设定库。经理窗口调度九个创作角色，book.json 单一状态源，写-审-改分离。

description_i18n.en: Novel Create Center: a gated web-novel pipeline — ideation, layered intake Q&A, frozen settings, three-level outline, golden three chapters, serialized daily chapters, five-domain review with revision loop, and book deconstruction feeding the setting vault. A manager window dispatches nine creative roles over a single book.json state source, with write/review/revise separated.
